content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text compares the challenger's seed/loins chain against the defender's chain and resolves the collision, so the chain-against-chain rule governs it.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"the challenger's seed/loins chain is footed but does not name Joseph as the begetter","rule_words":"A link is judged by its support, never by whether any verse, or the chain as a whole, states it word for word; and a verse whose words leave the question open decides nothing by itself.","room":"states it word for word: either the chain must explicitly name Joseph or it may support the point without exact naming; I read the judge as requiring exact naming.","why":"The judge calls the challenger's chain footed yet still underdetermined because it does not name Joseph, treating lack of exact naming as decisive rather than weighing chain against chain by footing."}
